about.title: About
about.subtitle: A brief introduction to who I am.
about.introP1: I am Rizkillah Ramanda Sinyo, a Software Engineer based in Pekanbaru, Riau, dedicated to building impactful digital solutions. I specialize in modern web platforms and full-stack development using modern tech stacks, including Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and AI/Machine Learning integration with Python.
about.introP2: My primary focus is designing software architectures that are not only functional but also well-structured, maintainable, and scalable to meet business and system performance needs. I believe that high-quality code must go hand-in-hand with system efficiency and logical clarity.
about.introP3: I blend technical expertise with proactive communication, critical thinking, and effective time management. I thrive in collaborative environments and am committed to ensuring that every project delivers optimal results and tangible real-world impact.
